start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my movements side by side." It runs tool:read-movement-pairs on my pursuit database and shows each pair with one play button.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the comparisons table of the pursuit database you name and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-movement-pairs and the input.
3. Read the answer: the pairs in place order. Show it with the screen the tool names.
